13. Planning and Engineering Services
13.1 Tender T26/27-05 Road Resurfacing Program 2026/27
File No: EGS/123
Purpose of Report
To consider tenders for the resurfacing of local roads in Baldivis and Warnbro.
Details
Submissions were assessed against the qualitative criteria. The evaluation panel recommends
the lowest priced conforming tender.
Officer Recommendation
That Council ACCEPTS Tender T26/27-05 from Example Civil Pty Ltd for the Road Resurfacing
Program 2026/27 for the lump sum of $900,000 (ex GST).
Committee Recommendation
That Council ACCEPTS Tender T26/27-05 from Example Civil Pty Ltd for the Road Resurfacing
Program 2026/27 for the lump sum of $850,000 (ex GST).
Council Resolution
Moved Cr Example E, seconded Cr Example F
That Council ACCEPTS Tender T26/27-05 from Example Civil Pty Ltd for the Road Resurfacing
Program 2026/27 for the lump sum of $850,000 (ex GST).
Carried 10/0
13.2 Safety Bay Road Footpath Extension
Purpose of Report
To consider a petition requesting a footpath along Safety Bay Road, Waikiki.
Officer Recommendation
That Council lists the footpath for consideration in the 2027/28 capital works budget.
Council Resolution
That Council DEFERS consideration of the footpath until the 2027/28 budget workshop.
Carried 10/0
13.3 Elected Member Training Policy
Purpose of Report
To adopt a revised policy.
